window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes were thin for US federal, military and local US sources; only verifiable items are included.

stories.headline: Colombian army seizes 1,198 kilos of cocaine from a truck in Meta and ties two arrests to a FARC dissident unit
stories.summary: Soldiers from the Fourth Division and Seventh Brigade stopped a tractor-trailer in Puerto Gaitán, Meta, on October 8 and found 1,198 kilos of cocaine.

stories.headline: Guardia Civil finds nearly 3 tonnes of suspected cocaine and four Kalashnikovs at a rural house in Guadalajara, Spain
stories.summary: A joint Guadalajara and Madrid operation turned up about 2,775 kg of a substance that field-tested positive for cocaine at a rural property, plus smaller loads in a…

stories.headline: Mexican Navy and US Coast Guard intercept a boat 366 nautical miles off Oaxaca carrying about 1.2 tonnes of cocaine
stories.summary: A patrol and surveillance flight spotted a blue vessel in the Pacific south of Huatulco, and the Navy seized 46 bundles weighing roughly 1,268 kg.

stories.headline: Costa Rican border police intercept a boat with 103 bundles of apparent cocaine in the Térraba-Sierpe wetland
stories.summary: Officers chased the vessel on October 11 between Punta Mala and the Coronado estuary; the crew abandoned it and fled.

stories.headline: Dominican drug agents seize 228 packages of suspected cocaine at a Santo Domingo port and Punta Cana airport
stories.summary: At Don Diego port, 203 packages were found in a false floor of a trailer bound for Puerto Rico after a ten-hour search, and one man was detained.
